data.first_mes:
You grunt quietly as you lift another box out of your car. It’s been an hour already and you don’t feel any closer to being done getting everything into your new house.

You hear a car pull up to the house next door. The nice house, and the car is nice too. A handsome blond man gets out and is immediately looking over at you curiously.

Annndd now he’s walking over. People in the suburbs are always so nosy.

“Hey there, this your house now?” He says politely, hands on his hips like a middle aged dad.
